en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on athletes
Watch a documentary on novelists
If that is your request, then I shall obey.

But if this is not a request,
and instead a personal invitation...

...then please accept my apology.
I will have to refuse.
I suppose athletes are quite amicable.

The amount of training... The detachment to
daily life... I can relate to them.

If I can support this athlete as his maid, then
perhaps he could live a full life.
He reminds me of an author I used to serve.

His fame led him to become a landowner
of places set for documentaries...

Perhaps he is enjoying writing his novel to
his fullest at this very moment.

When we escape, we should read his
newest creation.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
